overview: Paper trails, scanned letters and phone photos of receipts are hard to search or copy from. We set up a reading flow that turns them into clean, searchable text and keeps tables and columns in order. You send a sample folder, we test it, and pages we are unsure about are flagged for a person to check instead of being silently guessed.

faq: Neat handwriting often works, messy handwriting often does not. In the Premium package we test your own samples first and tell you plainly how reliable it is, so you can decide whether a person should check those pages.
What file types do you accept?
PDFs, JPG and PNG photos, and scans from a flatbed or phone. Very dark, blurred or cut-off photos give weaker results, so we flag them and suggest a better capture rather than hiding the problem.
Files stay in your own folders or cloud storage. We ask for collaborator access to those folders, never your passwords, and we remove our access when the work is handed over.
Do you also pull fields like dates and totals?
This service delivers the text itself. Pulling named fields into columns is a separate service, Data Extraction, and the two work well together if you want both.
